purpose: Correct the gameplay direction after independent REA provenance review; deliver first real manual-command milestone.
conclusion: The previous deliverable combines recovered assets and selected reverse-engineered numeric routines with newly authored simplified combat and UI. It is not a faithful reconstruction of the original gameplay. The replacement command bridge below restores player agency but is not claimed to reproduce the complete native FSM.

original_evidence.method: Reuse original REA pseudocode bound to the independently verified unchanged binary. No new full native decompilation.

functions.name: BattleFsmController.TriggerTurnStarted
functions.observation: Conditional branch calls FUN_18193ba20 then returns; metadata maps this target to StartAbilitySelectPhase.
functions.limitation: Exact business meaning of branch variables and the full selection-phase internals remain unproven.

functions.name: DamageModule.ApplyToTargets
functions.observation: Per-target damage pipeline contains context and persistent-effect modification; cannot be represented generally by summed damage multiplier.

functions.name: GetContextValue
functions.observation: Prior effect results contribute to context values.

batch_coverage.interpretation: Successful decompilation of a small selection is not full gameplay or source-equivalence validation.

before.behavior: RunBattle calculates entire match before replay. Skill callbacks only highlight; auto off multiplies presentation wait.

implemented: Default manual mode: prepare one actor, wait, choose executable skill and legal target, commit once, present that action, then prepare next actor.
Enemy and auto mode use the same validated command submission path.
Invalid commands and waiting queries leave combat state and all five RNG streams unchanged.
Unique actor/target instance identifiers prevent confusing equal base IDs.
Skill display follows executor order, resolves original icons by ability ID, disables cooldown/unexecutable skills.
Target list, numeric keys and health-bar pointer callbacks submit real targets.
Removed constant illustrative buff/debuff rows; no status icons without underlying state.
Regression tests include deterministic command replay, different choices, invalid commands, cooldown, real UI raycast/pointer dispatch and auto on/off.
remaining_fidelity_gaps: Flattened abilities still lose effect ordering, target categories, variance, contexts, triggers and expiry. The previously proven VADER 3.241+3.241 -> 6.482 error is NOT repaired by this milestone.
Leader/unique effects, taunt, dispel, assist/counter, protection, cooldown/turn-meter changes and full original targeting are not reconstructed.
Existing simplified AI and damage formulas were not certified against full original runtime behavior.
Scene, camera, animation timing, VFX, audio and NGUI hierarchy fidelity remain incomplete.
New command and target-list UI is an explicitly temporary reconstruction bridge, not recovered original source or original prefab.

Build is produced from the existing shared worktree, which contains earlier uncommitted UI/build-script edits. This change set commits only claimed battle code, new regressions and its evidence ledger.

zcode.outcome: Provider path resolved through process-local supported environment variables; model creation failed. No useful model review returned, no global config or credentials changed.

core.scope: State/RNG invariants, deterministic identical commands, changed choices, legality, cooldown, unique identities, auto/legacy compatibility; not full original parity.

checks: Manual default waits without combat progress.
Actual EventSystem raycast resolves expected button; its four corners stay inside viewport.
Pointer click selects real ability with non-null original icon; choosing a skill alone does not commit.
Pointer click on last legal target commits exactly once with expected ability and unique target IDs.
Double invocation cannot commit a second action.
Next player actor waits; auto on releases pending actor; auto off restores manual waiting.
playmode.limitations: Native batch GameView is 640x480. Stage/camera/rig framing remains visibly incomplete; these captures do not certify original visual fidelity.

smoke.scope: Standalone player boot; battle command and pointer regressions ran in PlayMode, not through live OS mouse input in the standalone player.
